description: Defines data structures, classes, and constants related to layer state management in Android's SurfaceFlinger, including layer properties, buffer data, display state, and related listeners.

classes.name: TrustedPresentationListener
classes.description: Listener for trusted presentation events, holding callback interface and ID.

classes.name: BufferData
classes.description: Represents buffer information for layers, including buffer handle, fences, frame number, and flags.

classes.name: layer_state_t
classes.description: Encapsulates the state of a layer, including properties like position, size, buffer, and visual attributes.

classes.name: ComposerState
classes.description: Associates a layer state with parcelable serialization methods.

classes.name: DisplayState
classes.description: Represents the state of a display, including surface, size, orientation, and layer stack.

classes.name: InputWindowCommands
classes.description: Holds focus requests and window info listeners, with methods to merge and manage commands.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls the callback interface to notify trusted presentation change.

methods.name: generateReleaseCallbackId
methods.description: Creates a unique ID for buffer release callbacks based on buffer ID and frame number.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another display or layer state into the current one.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the state based on permissions.

methods.name: hasValidBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the layer has a valid buffer.
